instruction: Candid studio photograph, full shot. Indoors, a girl in a maroon t-shirt and white pants (R2) stands on a light gray sofa on the left, wrapped in a Canadian flag like a cape, smiling at a boy in a red beanie and white t-shirt (R1). The boy (R1) stands on the right side of the sofa, body angled left, reaching his hand toward her cape with a playful expression. The background is a plain beige wall. The scene is illuminated by soft, warm light, highlighting the vibrant red of the flag and beanie against neutral tones.
